subject: Howison commemorative publication context
primary_or_contemporary_source: University of California Publications in Philosophy vol.1 catalogue/series notice
documented_finding: Volume I was prepared in commemoration of George Holmes Howison's seventieth birthday and lists Lovejoy's The Dialectic of Bruno and Spinoza at pp.141-174 with Lovejoy identified as Professor of Philosophy at Washington University.
evidence_limit: Does not establish Lovejoy attended any celebration or participated in the editorial committee.

subject: Contemporary characterization of Lovejoy paper
primary_or_contemporary_source: H. Heath Bawden review in Journal of Philosophy Psychology and Scientific Methods 2.9
documented_finding: Bawden describes Lovejoy's essay as an exposition and estimate of contradictory elements in Spinoza's system including unity/multiplicity and transcendence/immanence traced back through Neo-Platonism and Bruno.
evidence_limit: Review summary is not a substitute for full primary-article collation.

subject: Direct quotation of Lovejoy methodological claim
primary_or_contemporary_source: H. Heath Bawden review quoting Lovejoy
documented_finding: Bawden quotes Lovejoy on the origin of both sides of the contradiction in a single dialectical ground and the impossibility of surrendering either side without abandoning the method of philosophizing.
evidence_limit: Quotation should still be checked against the original 1904 page when full text is recovered.

subject: Otherworldliness lexical recurrence
primary_or_contemporary_source: lexical quotation index assigning passage to printed p.174
documented_finding: A quotation index attributes to Lovejoy's 1904 paper the phrase metaphysical otherworldliness and a contrast between true reality/value and common temporal experience.
evidence_limit: Pending direct verification against the original p.174 image.

subject: Return to Berkeley/Howison publication network
documented_finding: Lovejoy contributed as a Washington University professor to a UC philosophy volume explicitly prepared for his former Berkeley teacher Howison.
evidence_limit: Publication participation does not prove continuing doctrinal adherence to Howison.
